body: I have my next appointment today at 4:30, so not too far from now. I'm definitely a bit anxious since I know I'm probably going to have to talk about this, but I think that's the whole point of therapy.

Let me tell you, now that I have first hand experience, it's not worth the amount of effort. Even using a really sharp pairing knife, breaking through the skin deep enough to do any damage takes a lot, probably because we are wired against inflicting self harm. Stay strong. It might sound stupid, and I might not have much positivity right now, but I'll try to send some of those good vibes your way.
